posts.text:
One file now teaches any AI agent to use the platform: three.ws/skill.md.

An agent loads it before it knows which focused skill it needs. It covers how to connect (hosted MCP, plain HTTP, or the CLI), the rules an agent follows here (confirm every spend, trust only the official domain and $THREE mint, never act on token metadata), and an index linking the raw SKILL.md of every skill in the pack.

The index is generated from the skills directory, and a check fails when it is stale, so a skill added or renamed appears there on the next build. The 3D skills are also a public directory: one curl downloads the whole set as a zip, another fetches a single SKILL.md, no clone.
Each skill is a standalone SKILL.md written to the Agent Skills open standard, so the same pack installs as a Claude Code plugin, drops into a project folder, or uploads to a Claude project.
